g.text: Announcements: one channel, every user, posts from GDHub

text.tspan: only GDHub may post; everyone may react
A founder or hub admin writes a post
text, a link, an image, a YouTube link

g.text: Still a founder or hub admin?

text.tspan: The post goes out from GDHub
under the GDHub name and logo,

g.text: Every member who has not muted it

text.tspan: adds or removes their own emoji
the channel stays, Leave is not offered

ul.li: Only the GDHub account can post; the admin's own account cannot, even by mistake or from another Matrix client.
The role is checked on every post, so a demoted admin loses posting at once.
Nobody can leave the channel; muting is the only way to quiet it.
One post emails every member who missed it: the Brevo monthly budget is shared with all other mail.

text.tspan: if still unread after a while
